body.title: Add logging to LLM dataset generators
body.body: Currently, `LlamaDatasetGenerator` and `OpenAIDatasetGenerator` fail silently or work opaquely. There is no visibility into the generated prompts or raw responses. **Task:** - Add a logger to `src/agentunit/generators/llm_generator.py`. - Log the generated prompt (debug level). - Log the raw response text before parsing (debug level). - Log any parsing errors (error/warning level).

body.title: Add retry mechanism for malformed JSON in LLM generators
body.body: The `LlamaDatasetGenerator` and `OpenAIDatasetGenerator` currently raise a `ValueError` immediately if the LLM response cannot be parsed as JSON. **File:** `src/agentunit/generators/llm_generator.py` LLMs often fail 1-2 times before succeeding. **Task:** - Implement a simple retry loop (e.g., 3 attempts) when occurs. - Optionally, feed the error back to the LLM to correct its output in the next attempt.

body.title: Support parallel scenario execution
body.body: ### Summary Implement parallel scenario execution to speed up evaluation suites with many independent scenarios. ### Tasks - Add `--parallel` / `-j` flag to CLI (default: 1). - Use `concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor` or `ProcessPoolExecutor`. - Ensure thread-safe trace logging and result aggregation. - Add tests for parallel execution correctness. ### Acceptance criteria - `agentunit eval scenarios/ -j 4` runs 4 scenarios concurrently. - Results are identical to sequential execution. - No race conditions in trace or metrics collection.

body.title: Add dataset sampling strategies
body.body: ### Summary Implement dataset sampling strategies for large evaluation sets. ### Tasks - Add `DatasetSource.sample(n, strategy)` method. - Support strategies: random, stratified (by metadata field), first-n. - Ensure reproducibility with seed parameter. - Document sampling in dataset docs. ### Acceptance criteria - `dataset.sample(100, strategy="stratified", field="difficulty")` works. - Same seed produces same sample. - Original dataset unchanged.

body.title: Add retry decorator with exponential backoff
body.body: ### Summary Add retry logic with exponential backoff for flaky API calls in adapters. ### Tasks - Create a `@retry` decorator in `agentunit.core.utils`. - Support configurable max_retries, base_delay, max_delay. - Log retry attempts with backoff duration. - Apply to built-in adapters that make external API calls. ### Acceptance criteria - Transient failures retry automatically. - Permanent failures surface after max retries. - Decorator is reusable for custom adapters.

body.title: Support async adapters
body.body: ### Summary Add support for async adapters to handle agents that use `async/await`. ### Tasks - Create `AsyncBaseAdapter` with `async def execute()`. - Update `run_suite()` to detect and await async adapters. - Add example async adapter in docs/templates. - Ensure backwards compatibility with sync adapters. ### Acceptance criteria - Async adapters work with `asyncio.run()` or event loop. - Mixed sync/async scenarios in same suite work. - Tests cover async execution path.

body.title: Add result caching for unchanged scenarios
body.body: ### Summary Implement result caching to skip re-running unchanged scenarios. ### Tasks - Hash scenario inputs (dataset, adapter config) to create cache keys. - Store results in `.agentunit_cache/` directory. - Add `--no-cache` flag to force fresh runs. - Invalidate cache when source files change. ### Acceptance criteria - Repeated runs with same inputs use cached results. - Cache hit/miss is logged. - `--no-cache` bypasses cache completely.

body.title: Add LangGraph integration tests
body.body: ### Summary Add integration tests that verify AgentUnit works with real LangGraph agents. ### Tasks - Create a simple LangGraph agent in `tests/integration/`. - Write integration test that runs a full evaluation cycle. - Use pytest markers to skip if LangGraph not installed. - Document how to run integration tests. ### Acceptance criteria - Integration tests pass with LangGraph installed. - Tests are skipped gracefully without LangGraph. - CI optionally runs integration tests.

body.title: Add LLM cost tracking and budgeting
body.body: ### Summary Add cost tracking and estimation for LLM-based evaluations. ### Tasks - Track token usage in trace events. - Calculate estimated cost based on model pricing. - Add `--cost-limit` flag to abort if budget exceeded. - Include cost summary in reports. ### Acceptance criteria - Token counts captured in trace. - Cost estimates shown in results. - Evaluation stops gracefully at cost limit.

body.title: Create pytest plugin for scenario discovery
body.body: ### Summary Create a pytest plugin that allows running AgentUnit evaluations as pytest tests. ### Tasks - Create `pytest-agentunit` plugin (can be in-repo or separate). - Auto-discover scenario files in `tests/eval/`. - Report scenario results as pytest test outcomes. - Support pytest markers for filtering scenarios. ### Acceptance criteria - `pytest --agentunit` runs evaluation scenarios. - Failed scenarios appear as failed tests. - Integrates with pytest fixtures.

body.title: Add --watch mode for continuous evaluation
body.body: ### Summary Add a `--watch` mode to the CLI that re-runs evaluations when source files change. ### Tasks - Add `watchfiles` or similar as an optional dependency. - Implement `agentunit eval --watch` that monitors `tests/` and `src/` for changes. - Re-run the specified scenario(s) on file save. - Print a summary after each run. ### Acceptance criteria - `agentunit eval scenarios/ --watch` works. - Graceful exit on Ctrl+C. - Documentation updated in CLI help.

body.title: Add baseline comparison with regression detection
body.body: ### Summary Implement baseline comparison that fails CI if metrics regress beyond a threshold. ### Tasks - Add `agentunit baseline save` to store current results as baseline. - Add `agentunit eval --fail-on-regression` to compare against baseline. - Support configurable thresholds per metric. - Output diff report showing improvements/regressions. ### Acceptance criteria - Baseline file stored in `.agentunit/baseline.json`. - CI fails if any metric drops more than threshold. - Clear diff output showing metric changes.

body.title: Support custom metrics via YAML configuration
body.body: ### Summary Allow users to define custom metrics via YAML configuration instead of Python code. ### Tasks - Define YAML schema for custom metrics (name, formula, thresholds). - Parse and register metrics from `agentunit.yaml` or similar config file. - Support simple formulas referencing built-in metrics (e.g., `(faithfulness + tool_success) / 2`). - Document the schema in docs. ### Acceptance criteria - Custom metrics defined in YAML appear in results. - Invalid YAML produces clear error messages. - Documentation includes examples.

body.title: Add streaming output for live evaluation progress
body.body: ### Summary Implement streaming output support for long-running evaluations. ### Tasks - Add `--stream` flag to CLI that prints results as scenarios complete. - Use rich/click progress bars for visual feedback. - Show running metrics (pass/fail count, current scenario). - Support both TTY and non-TTY output modes. ### Acceptance criteria - `agentunit eval scenarios/ --stream` shows live progress. - Works correctly when piped to file. - No buffering issues on slow evaluations.

body.title: Add scenario tagging and filtering
body.body: ### Summary Implement scenario tagging and filtering for selective evaluation runs. ### Tasks - Add `tags` field to Scenario definition. - Implement `--tags` / `--exclude-tags` CLI filters. - Support tag expressions (e.g., `--tags "smoke and not slow"`). - Document tagging in scenario docs. ### Acceptance criteria - `agentunit eval scenarios/ --tags smoke` runs only tagged scenarios. - Tag expressions with AND/OR/NOT work. - Untagged scenarios have sensible default behavior.

body.title: Create VS Code extension for AgentUnit configs
body.body: ### Summary Create a VS Code extension that provides syntax highlighting and validation for AgentUnit YAML configs. ### Tasks - Set up VS Code extension scaffolding. - Add JSON schema for `agentunit.yaml` files. - Provide hover documentation for config keys. - Add snippets for common patterns. ### Acceptance criteria - Extension installable from VSIX. - YAML validation shows errors inline. - Autocomplete works for known keys.

body.title: Add test for markdown report emoji encoding
body.body: ### Summary Add test for `SuiteResult.to_markdown()` to verify emoji characters render correctly. ### Tasks - Add a test in `tests/test_reporting.py` (or create if needed). - Create a `SuiteResult` with passing and failing runs. - Assert the markdown output contains ✅ and ❌ characters. - Verify UTF-8 encoding is preserved. ### Acceptance criteria - Test passes on all platforms (including Windows). - `poetry run pytest` passes.

body.title: Add py.typed marker for type checker support
body.body: ### Summary Add `py.typed` marker file to indicate the package supports type checking. ### Tasks - Create an empty `src/agentunit/py.typed` file. - Verify it's included in the package build. ### Acceptance criteria - `py.typed` file exists at `src/agentunit/py.typed`. - `poetry build` includes the file in the distribution.

body.title: Add missing type hints to DatasetCase
body.body: ### Summary Add type hints to the `DatasetCase` dataclass fields that currently lack them. ### Tasks - Review `src/agentunit/datasets/base.py` for missing or incomplete type hints. - Add `str`, `list[str]`, `dict[str, Any]`, etc. where appropriate. - Ensure `from __future__ import annotations` is present. ### Acceptance criteria - All fields in `DatasetCase` have explicit type hints. - `poetry run ruff check .` passes. - Tests pass.

body.title: Improve test coverage for metrics registry
body.body: ### Summary Improve test coverage for `src/agentunit/metrics/registry.py`. ### Tasks - Add tests for `register_metric()` and `get_metric()` edge cases. - Test behavior when registering a duplicate metric name. - Test behavior when requesting a non-existent metric. ### Acceptance criteria - New tests in `tests/test_metrics_registry.py` (or similar). - `poetry run pytest` passes. - Coverage for `registry.py` increases.

body.title: Expose __version__ in agentunit package
body.body: ### Summary Add a `__version__` attribute to the main `agentunit` package for programmatic version access. ### Tasks - Add `__version__ = "0.7.0"` (or use `importlib.metadata`) in `src/agentunit/__init__.py`. - Ensure it matches `pyproject.toml` version. ### Acceptance criteria - `import agentunit; print(agentunit.__version__)` works. - Version matches pyproject.toml.

body.title: Add docstrings to BaseAdapter methods
body.body: ### Summary Add docstrings to public methods in `src/agentunit/adapters/base.py` that are missing them. ### Tasks - Add Google-style docstrings to `prepare()`, `execute()`, `cleanup()` in `BaseAdapter`. - Include brief parameter and return descriptions. ### Acceptance criteria - All public methods have docstrings. - `poetry run ruff check .` passes.

body.title: Fix typos in docstrings
body.body: ### Summary Fix typos and improve clarity in existing docstrings across the codebase. ### Tasks - Search for common typos (e.g., "recieve", "occured", "paramter"). - Review docstrings in `src/agentunit/core/` for grammar issues. - Fix any found issues. ### Acceptance criteria - No obvious typos in docstrings. - `poetry run ruff check .` passes.

body.title: Add basic evaluation example script
body.body: ### Summary Add a simple example script showing how to run a basic evaluation with AgentUnit. ### Tasks - Create `examples/basic_evaluation.py` with a minimal working example. - Use the built-in `FakeAdapter` pattern or a simple mock. - Include comments explaining each step. ### Acceptance criteria - Script runs without errors: `python examples/basic_evaluation.py`. - Code is well-commented for newcomers. - No new dependencies required.

body.title: Add smoke test for suite_template FAQAdapter
body.body: ### Summary Add a minimal pytest that exercises the `FAQAdapter` sample pattern from `docs/templates/suite_template.py` to ensure the template stays valid. ### Tasks - Create a new test (e.g., `tests/test_suite_template_smoke.py`). - Mock a simple agent with `.connect()` and `.answer()` returning the expected string. - Reuse or inline the dataset/adapters from the template to run one scenario. - Assert success and that a response is recorded. ### Acceptance criteria - Test passes via `poetry run pytest`. - No new lint issues. - Keeps dependencies limited to existing test stack.

body.title: Clarify local CI commands in README
body.body: ### Summary Add a short "Run CI locally" section to `README.md` that mirrors the GitHub Actions steps. ### Tasks - Document prerequisites: Python 3.10+, Poetry. - Add commands: - `poetry install --with dev` - `poetry check` - `poetry run ruff check .` - `poetry run ruff format --check .` - `poetry run pytest` - Keep it concise (5-7 lines) and in Markdown list form. ### Acceptance criteria - Section present in `README.md`. - Commands match current CI. - Markdown renders cleanly.

body.title: Pin datetime usage to timezone-aware helper
body.body: ### Summary Create a small helper (or inline change) to replace all uses of `datetime.utcnow()` with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` and centralize formatting if feasible. ### Tasks - Add `from datetime import datetime, timezone` where needed. - Replace `datetime.utcnow()` with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. - Optionally add a tiny helper in `agentunit/benchmarks/leaderboard.py` to format timestamps. - Ensure existing formatting `strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")` remains unchanged. ### Acceptance criteria - No remaining `datetime.utcnow()` in the repo. - Tests pass: `poetry run pytest`. - No new ruff warnings.

body.title: Add sample scenario tests for suite_template.py
body.body: ### Summary Provide a minimal unit test that imports `docs/templates/suite_template.py` (or a copy under `tests/fixtures`) and executes the sample `FAQAdapter` against the bundled dataset to demonstrate expected structure. ### Suggested changes - Create a small test in `tests/` that: - Imports or copies the `FAQAdapter`/`DatasetSource` setup from `docs/templates/suite_template.py`. - Mocks a simple agent with `.connect()` and `.answer()` to return the expected string. - Asserts that `Scenario.run()` (or equivalent) produces a successful `AdapterOutcome`. - Keep dependencies limited to the existing test stack (pytest only). ### Why this is beginner-friendly - Touches only test files and uses…

body.title: Add quickstart instructions for running CI checks locally
body.body: ### Summary Document how to run the same checks as CI (lint, format check, tests) so new contributors can validate changes before opening a PR. ### Suggested changes - Update `README.md` (or create `CONTRIBUTING.md` section) with a short "Local CI" snippet: - `poetry install --with dev` - `poetry check` - `poetry run ruff check .` - `poetry run ruff format --check .` - `poetry run pytest` - Mention Python 3.10+ requirement and Poetry usage. ### Why this is beginner-friendly - Pure documentation change with copy/paste commands. - Helps first-time contributors avoid CI failures. ### Acceptance criteria - New section exists with the above commands and context. - Commands are accurate for the c…

body.title: Refactor datetime.utcnow usages to timezone-aware datetime
body.body: ### Summary Replace deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` calls with timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (or equivalent) to silence deprecation warnings and keep timestamps correct. ### Suggested changes - In `src/agentunit/benchmarks/leaderboard.py` and any other occurrences, import `datetime` and `timezone` and use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` before formatting. - Keep the existing string formatting (`strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")`). - Add a small unit test (or extend existing tests) to ensure the timestamp generation still works. ### Why this is beginner-friendly - The changes are localized to a small number of lines. - Clear before/after behavior with easy-to-run tests (`poetry run pytest`…

body.title: fix: add explicit utf-8 encoding for Windows compatibility
body.body: ## Description This PR fixes a `UnicodeEncodeError` that occurs on Windows systems when generating Markdown reports. The issue arises because `pathlib.Path.write_text()` defaults to the system's locale encoding if not specified. When the report generator attempts to write emojis to the report file the operation fails on Windows. This change explicitly sets `encoding="utf-8"` when writing the report ensuring cross platform compatibility. Fixes # (Bug discovered during local setup, no existing issue ID) ## Type of Change - [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) ## Changes Made - Modified `src/agentunit/reporting/results.py`: Added `encoding="utf-8"` argument to the `write_text…
